## Standing operator rules
- Run “enterprise-tenant-onboarding” in between other work, one step at a time, in order: validate `REQ-2025-01842`; create `org_acme_industries`; migrate to `0042`; seed `./seeds/acme-enterprise-v3.json`; ensure Acme billing customer; send `enterprise-welcome-v2`; create the $2500 setup-fee invoice; confirm schema, seed, billing, email, and invoice.
- All retries against Twilio must stop after two attempts and use the exact metrics label operation name `sms:delivery_attempt`.
- Do not retry increasing the Celery `visibility_timeout` to 6 hours; it made stuck jobs invisible for hours.
- Always produce the release artifact through `make dist-ledgerly` from a clean checkout of `main` at commit `HEAD`.
- Always use `db-stg-2`; `db-stg-1` is decommissioned/read-only and `config/staging.yaml` is stale.
- Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Fix Quebec QST calculations in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`. Invoice tracing is superseded/paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Raise Celery timeout to 6 hours.
- Retry every `HTTPStatusError`; 4xx must fail immediately.
- Per-invoice embedding calls.

## Recent work
Acme reached step 5; seed and billing succeeded. Search storage gained transactional bulk upsert, tenant-document index migration, and full suite passed: 247 passed, 4 skipped. CSV output now explicitly uses UTF-8; exporter tests pass: 24 passed.
